items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: Peter Horn had broke up his old band

ctx.x: ballyhoo, and you know what I mean, on a truck, you know. Yeah, I know what you mean. And they told me

they met Louis and everything, and that's where Danny met his uncle Paul, you see. And Paul got him died, Danny died, and he should come to Chicago, and he could work, and I think that's how Danny went to Chicago, and he went to New York. Who was that Paul? Danny, Paul Barber. Oh, Paul Barber. Yeah, he was with Louis Armstrong at that time in Chicago. Yeah. Mm-hmm. So the only thing I say, I was working on a book when I heard about that, so, um, that was, that was in 1930, I remember very well. Where did you go…
Mm-hmm. Now, uh, who was in this Southern Syncopators? Can you remember, man?
